subject.title: docs(cli): generate and guard command reference

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new command catalog and plugin CLI metadata API as the canonical source for public generated command documentation?
rationale: The scheduling defect is mechanically repairable, but this PR also depends on a durable new public CLI/plugin contract whose acceptance cannot be inferred while the RFC and foundation PR remain open.

options.title: Approve and sequence the stack
options.body: Accept and land the catalog foundation after API review, then rebase and repair this generated-docs follow-up.

options.title: Pause generated command docs
options.body: Keep this dependent draft unmerged until maintainers decide whether the catalog and plugin metadata contract should become public product surface.

recommendation.title: Approve and sequence the stack
recommendation.body: Accept and land the catalog foundation after API review, then rebase and repair this generated-docs follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent history owns the docs changed-lane and adjacent CLI descriptor refactors, making him the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
